newsitem.title: USA: Meadowbrook not trading after imbalance.
newsitem.headline: Meadowbrook not trading after imbalance.

text.p: Shares of Meadowbrook Insurance Group Inc were not trading Wednesday because of an order imbalance on the New York Stock Exchange.
Meadowbrook's stock, which stopped trading shortly before the market closed Tuesday, had an indicated bid price of $14 a share and ask of $15 a share. It closed Tuesday at 26-3/8.

On Wednesday, the company announced third quarter earnings of $0.05 versus $0.38 a year ago. Meadowbrook, an alternative risk management company, said earnings fell mostly because of higher than expected losses in a discontinued portion of its surety bond business.

The company said the after-tax earnings shortfall for the quarter was $2.9 million, compared to its expected projected earnings of $3.6 million. The unprofitble surety results were produced by agents who have been terminated by the company, it said.
Meadowbrook said it has been forced to delay implementation of several new programs for several months. Eight new programs will start in the fourth quarter of 1996 or first quarter of 1997, it said.
